business_problem: The migration itself carried significant technical risk. Moving large production databases that supported global operations required careful execution to minimize downtime and maintain data consistency. Regional compliance requirements added another layer of complexity, and certain services needed full re-architecture rather than a simple lift-and-shift.
solution_summary: The migration placed Smarten Spaces' development environment entirely on Google Cloud , built on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) for container orchestration, for managed databases, and for caching. The architecture supports AI workloads through Gemini in Vertex AI . As Smarten Spaces' data strategy evolves, the team plans to introduce BigQuery Looker for analytics and reporting. The decision to migrate was driven by a combination of strategic and operational factors. A key client in Singapore was already using as its LLM, and this created an opportunity for deeper integration that could benefit the broader customer base. At the same time, alternate cloud providers offered only preset machine configurations thereby limiting flexibility in matching resources to workload requirements and making it harder to optimize infrastructure usage efficiently.
